description: This file defines TypeScript interfaces and functions for managing Nostr account configurations within the openclaw project, including resolving account IDs, listing accounts, and deriving public keys from private keys.

methods.name: resolveConfiguredDefaultNostrAccountId
methods.description: Resolves the default Nostr account ID from the given configuration.

methods.name: listNostrAccountIds
methods.description: Lists all configured Nostr account IDs based on the configuration.

methods.name: resolveDefaultNostrAccountId
methods.description: Gets the default Nostr account ID from the configuration.

methods.name: resolveNostrAccount
methods.description: Resolves a Nostr account object from the configuration and optional account ID.
